decision_changed: A recovering site adds argument structure to the corpus, and its C, authored against canonical control v2, joins the comparable set directly. A capability stop would be notable because the cue is maximally local -- one function word, one token back -- so failure could not be blamed on cue distance.
novelty_delta: Twenty-first behaviour. Prior-art search returns 0 events for voice, passive, active, by and agent. The corpus has no VOICE variable. A passive auxiliary makes the following slot an agent phrase and obliges ' by'; the same verb in the active takes a direct object and so ' the'. The cue is a single function word (was versus then) one token before an identical participle, and what changes is the ARGUMENT STRUCTURE of the clause rather than the identity of a following word -- distinct from preposition_selection, where the verb's lexical entry fixes the preposition, and from modal_remoteness, where a subordinate clause fixes an auxiliary. Recipient and donor differ only in that function word and end on the same participle token.
